candidates.description: DeepSeek-Reasonix before 2.53.0 contains a command execution vulnerability that allows attackers to run commands without user approval because the shellsafe classifier treats git blame and git whatchanged as read-only. Attackers can plant a diff textconv driver in .gitattributes and .git/config so that git blame, triggered via prompt injection or routine use, executes attacker-chosen commands with the user's privileges, exposing stored provider API keys and session history.

candidates.description: llama.cpp from b7118 before b12604 contains an integer underflow vulnerability in llama_grammar_parser::parse_sequence() that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to cause denial of service by supplying GBNF repetitions with max lower than min. Attackers can send a grammar like {5,2} in the grammar field of a llama-server /completion request, wrapping n_opt to generate endless repetition rules that hang the process and exhaust memory.
